## WF-D — Error handler

Set as the **Error Workflow** on A, B and C (Workflow settings → Error workflow).

Without this a failed intake is silent: the prospect sees a 200 and the lead is gone. Executions prune after 168h, so the alert carries the message inline, not just a link.

The topic is **public**, and n8n error messages routinely embed the failing payload — Postgres quotes the SQL and the offending value, nodemailer quotes the envelope recipient (`all recipients were rejected: someone@example.com`). An attacker can force one on demand by submitting an address the relay rejects, so the message is email-redacted and truncated to 120 chars. Workflow, node and execution id are operator-side and stay verbatim.
